shift_exercise_to_best_window.method: Shifts 30 min outdoor exercise (4x breathing factor) from 06:30 to the cleanest 2h window.
assumptions: 30 min session at 4.0x resting inhalation rate
Diurnal PM2.5 follows hourly forecast

exercise_indoors_when_poor.method: Moves 30 min workout indoors (2.5x indoor breathing factor vs 4.0x outdoor).
assumptions: Indoor workout inhalation factor 2.5x
Main room follows single-zone indoor PM2.5

n95_for_open_transport.method: Applies N95/FFP2 penetration factor (0.2 base; 0.1-0.4 sensitivity range) to open-air slots.
assumptions: Assumes fitted N95/FFP2 seal (80% base reduction; 60-90% range)
Does not alter closed car/metro cabin

commute_to_public_transport.method: Replaces private commute emissions with public bus; compares 1.0x outdoor bus exposure against cabin.
assumptions: Car cabin 0.6x outdoor, bus 1.0x outdoor
48 working weeks/year; DEFRA/India GHG factor ranges

wfh_on_worst_day.method: Converts 1 commute day/week to home-based day and removes 1 round-trip of tailpipe CO2e.
assumptions: Eliminates 1 round-trip/week across 48 weeks
Home air modeled via single-zone mass balance

no_idling.method: Cuts 5 min/day engine idling (0.6-1.0 L/h petrol, 250 days/yr * 2.31 kg CO2/L).
assumptions: Idling fuel burn 0.6-1.0 L/h assumption
Also avoids concentrated tailpipe PM/NOx near school gates

errands_in_best_window.method: Schedules discretionary errands into the lowest 2h outdoor PM2.5 window (08:00-20:00).
assumptions: Based on next 24h forecast window means

child_play_indoors_when_poor.method: Preventive threshold guidance for children (higher minute ventilation per body weight) at L3+.
assumptions: Applies US EPA child sensitive-group activity threshold

trip_chaining.method: Assumes 10% (range 5-15%) annual distance reduction by combining stops with existing commutes.
assumptions: 10% distance reduction assumption (5-15% sensitivity)

air_house_in_best_window.method: Replaces morning/evening window opening with the cleanest 2h midday window (or keeps shut at L4+).
assumptions: Window-open ACH a=4.0 h^-1 (3.5-4.5); closed normal a=0.7 h^-1 (0.5-1.0)

close_windows_at_peak.method: Removes baseline window-opening hours that overlap the worst 3h outdoor smog peak.
assumptions: Closing windows shifts a from 4.0 to 0.7 h^-1 during avoid hours

run_purifier_through_night.method: Extends owned purifier operation from evening-only (18-22) to all home-occupied hours including sleep.
assumptions: Effective ACH q = derate * CADR / (area * 2.7m)
Derate 0.5 base (0.3-0.7 range); capped at 80%

diy_box_fan_filter.method: Single-zone mass balance with DIY box-fan filter (200 m3/h CADR) across all home hours.
assumptions: Conservative CADR 200 m3/h with 0.5 derate (0.3-0.7 range)
Ceiling height 2.7 m

buy_hepa_purifier.method: Single-zone mass balance with HEPA purifier (250 m3/h CADR) across all home hours.
assumptions: CADR 250 m3/h with 0.5 derate (0.3-0.7 range)
Displayed room reduction capped at 80%

seal_gaps_and_door_sweeps.method: Improves home envelope from leaky (a=2.0 h^-1) to normal closed (a=0.7 h^-1).
assumptions: Leaky a=2.0 (1.7-2.3), normal closed a=0.7 (0.5-1.0)

cooking_ventilation.method: Halves cooking particle source S during hours 07 and 19 via exhaust/cross-ventilation.
assumptions: Cooking S: biomass 60, other 25, LPG 10 ug/m3/h (+-50% range)
Exhaust halves S

damp_mop_dont_sweep.method: Qualitative dust-resuspension prevention (wet mopping avoids lifting settled PM into breathing zone).
assumptions: Indoor resuspension not parameterized in single-zone mass balance

avoid_indoor_smoke_sources.method: Qualitative source control: eliminates indoor incense, mosquito coil, and candle aerosol spikes.
assumptions: Avoids acute indoor peak emissions in closed winter rooms

lpg_instead_of_biomass.method: Reduces indoor cooking source S from biomass (60 ug/m3/h) to LPG (10 ug/m3/h) at cooking hours.
assumptions: Cooking source S assumption with +-50% sensitivity range

induction_cooking.method: Eliminates gas burner indoor combustion source S (10 -> 0 ug/m3/h during hours 07 & 19).
assumptions: Cooking source S assumption (+-50%); frying aerosols still require exhaust

warmth_without_burning.method: Guidance swap replacing biomass/coal warming fires with safe layering or electric heating.
assumptions: Prevents neighbourhood biomass smoke and indoor carbon monoxide hazards

carpool_shared_ride.method: Halves per-person car CO2e (2 occupants) while keeping closed-cabin filtration/recirculation.
assumptions: Assumes 2 commuters sharing an existing car trip
48 working weeks/year

walk_or_cycle_short_trips.method: Zero-emission active travel on short <= 3 km trips when air is Good-Sensitive (L0-L2).
assumptions: Suppressed automatically at L3+ to avoid high-breathing outdoor smog exposure

community_no_burning.method: Collective street/guard action halting open leaf, trash, and coal burning.
assumptions: Community-level qualitative impact

society_dust_and_diesel_audit.method: RWA operational audit of construction dust covers, wet sweeping, and DG-set maintenance.
assumptions: Community-level qualitative impact

share_community_brief.method: Distributes printable 1-page air action brief to RWAs and school parent groups.
assumptions: Community-level qualitative impact
